description: Erection of a two-storey rear extension.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - By reason of the scale, design and siting of the proposed extension it is considered that it would fail to maintain subservience to the application property and disrupt the rhythm of the terrace, failing to complement the form, setting, period and detailing of the host building and causing harm to the character of the area. The proposal is therefore considered to be contrary to Local Plan Policies LP1 and LP5.

Reason : 2 - By reason of the scale, design and siting of the proposed flank wall of the addition, it is considered that it would have any unacceptable impact on the amenity of the occupants of the adjacent property, by significantly increasing their sense of enclosure, causing an unacceptable overbearing impact, contrary to Local Plan Policy LP2 and the Councils Housing SPD.

Reason : 3 - By reason of lack of information provided, the Council cannot be satisfied that no trees of amenity value would be damaged or destroyed as a result of the proposed development, contrary to Local Plan Policy LP56.

Reason : 4 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
